title: Emerald Coast Oasis - Vacation Rental in Seacrest Beach West,FL | 30a Escapes
description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents..."Emerald Coast Oasis", a one-of-a-kind retreat in Seacrest West! Relax by your private pool or take a short stroll to the sugar-white sands just steps away. As the sun sets, savor al fresco dining and cocktails under a canopy of stars. Designed with a seamless indoor-outdoor layout and refined custom details, this stunning retreat perfectly blends comfort with sophistication. Plus, enjoy 6 beach cruisers to explore the scenic beauty of 30A in style! Learn more below...*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Steps to the Gulf Coast with deeded beach access – Enjoy effortless access to pristine white sands and turquoise waters.Private Pool – Relax in your own serene oasis, perfect for sunny afternoons or starlit evenings by the pool.Spacious Fenced-In Backyard - Enjoy a lush, green outdoor space with ample room for relaxation and play. Features cozy covered porches and beautifully maintained greenery.Seamless Indoor-Outdoor living on a Single Level – Experience an open, thoughtfully designed layout that prioritizes comfort, connection, and unforgettable moments shared together.Chef’s Kitchen with Premium Appliances and Dual Islands – Cook and entertain in style with a kitchen built for culinary creativity and shared meals.6 Bikes provided to explore 30A – Discover the charm of nearby beaches and towns on two wheels, with scenic rides perfect for adventure or a leisurely pace.Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐ “The private pool and beach access made our family vacation perfect.” – Lisa B.⭐ “Loved the outdoor barbecue and dining space for our group dinners. The house was fantastic!” – Kelly K.⭐ “Fantastic location and house layout! It’s even better than the pictures. Highly recommended!” – Jared P.*** LIVING AREA ***The open-concept living areas are designed to bring the indoors and outdoors together effortlessly, offering stunning views of the pool at every turn. Expansive floor-to-ceiling windows blur the lines between inside and out, flooding the space with natural light and creating a true indoor-outdoor sanctuary. Plush sofas, a sleek cocktail bar, and smart TVs add comfort, making it the perfect retreat for relaxation.Seamless indoor-outdoor living with breathtaking pool views from the living and dining spacesSpacious open-concept area with plush seating, a stylish cocktail bar, and a smart TV for ultimate comfort*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***This chef-inspired kitchen is a dream come true for food enthusiasts. Featuring two spacious islands and state-of-the-art appliances like ice maker, it streamlines meal preparation with ease. The farmhouse-style dining table with serene pool views comfortably seats up to 10 guests, perfect for gatherings. A dedicated bar area, complete with a wine fridge, invites you to craft the perfect cocktails in style.Six-burner gas stove, dual ovens, and a spacious fridge/freezer to handle all your cooking needsTwo sinks and a cocktail bar with a wine fridge for effortless prep and entertainingTwo large islands for extra workspace and additional seatingFarmhouse dining table for 10, plus seating for 5 at the kitchen island*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***Step into your own private oasis! Bask in the Florida sunshine by the seasonally heated pool, surrounded by comfortable loungers, or enjoy a meal in the shaded dining area. Complete with a grill and stylish wet bar, this space is perfect for relaxing days under the sun or magical evenings stargazing beneath the night sky.Private pool seasonally heated from September to April.Outdoor cooking area featuring a gas grill, mini fridge, and sinkSpacious shaded patio complete with a lounging area and dining table that seats 8*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***This exquisite villa features four beautifully designed bedrooms and three contemporary bathrooms, perfectly combining comfort and luxury. The primary suite offers direct access to the pool deck, creating a serene private retreat. The additional bedrooms are thoughtfully arranged to accommodate various group needs, each providing convenient access to the modern bathrooms.Primary Suite: King bed, smart TV, and patio access. En-suite with a Jacuzzi tub, double vanity, and rain shower.King Guest Suite: King bed, en-suite with standing shower and stylish black-and-white tiling.Queen Guest Suite: Queen bed, shares access to a spacious hallway bathroom.Queen Guest Suite: Queen bed conveniently located near shared hallway bath.Bonus Room: Two custom Twin-over-Twin bunks, smart TV and lounge area with pool deck access - perfect for kids!Hallway Bathroom: A spacious, well-appointed bathroom featuring a walk-in shower. Conveniently located near the bunk room, it also offers easy access to the pool for added practicality.*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Nestled in the sought-after Seacrest community, “Emerald Coast Oasis” offers the perfect getaway just moments from pristine beaches, exceptional dining, and premier shopping. Discover local favorites at The Big Chill or take a scenic bike ride to the charming neighborhoods of Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach for even more adventure!Deeded beach access – Just a 6-minute walk away, perfect for soaking up the sun and enjoying serene coastal views.The Big Chill – A short ride (4-minute drive) to a lively spot for live music, delicious local eats, and a vibrant community atmosphere.Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach – Both under 5 minutes drive away, offering stunning architecture, boutique shopping, and a relaxed, upscale beach-town vibe.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included but can be purchased separately.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.3 cars can park off to the side of the house, and 2 cars can park in the front driveway, but the garage is not for guest use.Waiver required to get access to 6 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.The private pool is heated from September 1 to April 30.LSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 50028STRO #: STR-050028
